data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Nothing more than crappy Chinese furniture](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/695db7cc7d9f845fb0160d96)
I’ve had a pretty rough experience with Lulu & Georgia. I spent nearly 10k on lighting and furniture to furnish a master bedroom. What started assomewhat positive experience and since flipped 180. It started with a dresser that came with misaligned drawers. They provided resolution that I accepted. Then a damaged lighting fixture, for which I accepted a price adjustment (making it final sale) before realizing that it was completely crooked on installation. Then multiple bed deliveries with the same defect. Customer service has since been giving me the run around without resolution. I had a custom fabric order on a bench that took nearly three months to make and it came with PLASTIC legs, not the wood carved legs that the description promised. On top of that, it looks like it was sewed by someone blindfolded. The quality is totally crap for the high price paid. I’m so incredibly disappointed that not one item has arrived in good condition, especially with how expensive this place is.

October 27, 2025

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jan 8, 2026

Hi Ida,

Thank you for reaching out to us and sharing your experience. We sincerely apologize for the ongoing issues you've faced with your order. We understand how frustrating it is to receive items with defects or quality concerns. For your dresser, we arranged for a professional technician to inspect and repair the misaligned drawers, and we also issued a partial refund to your original payment method. Regarding the Ansel Bench, we’ve contacted the supplier for clarification about the leg material and quality, and we’ll keep you updated as soon as we have more information. Lastly, we want you to be happy with every piece—in light of your experience with the Koppel bed, we’re keeping the option open for you to return it for a full refund to your original payment method if you prefer. Please let us know if you have any further questions—we’re here to help and want to restore your confidence in us.
